service.name: Beatles sing-along duo
service.serviceType: A Beatles sing-along for senior living, community events and private parties
service.description: Your Bird Can Sing is a two-musician Beatles sing-along. The duo plays the songs and hands out lyric booklets so the audience sings with them, and it books as one duo across the Denver area, the Front Range and the mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What is Your Bird Can Sing?
faqs.a: A Beatles sing-along led by two musicians, booked through Signet Artists in Denver. The duo plays the songs, everyone gets a lyric booklet, and it books for senior living communities, library programs and family parties.

faqs.q: Is this a Beatles tribute band?
faqs.a: No. Two musicians play the Beatles songbook as themselves, hand out the words, and lead the audience through the songs.

faqs.q: Does anyone need to be able to sing?
faqs.a: No. The booklets have the words and the duo leads the melody, so anyone who wants to sing can, and anyone who would rather sit and listen is welcome to.

faqs.q: Do you bring your own sound?
faqs.a: Yes. The duo brings sound support that's the right size for the venue, so you don't need a system of your own.
Yes. The duo plays Denver, the Front Range and the mountain towns, and travel past the metro is quoted as its own line on the contract.
Yes, in a courtyard, a backyard or a park, with shade over the musicians and an outlet within reach. What happens if it rains is on the technical page.
